controlling_rules: H/A/N, physical venue/location meaning, score, date, result and game type are historical meaning after Integration Freeze and may be investigated/recommended but not silently mutated before Owner Gate 1.

Conditional discrepancy applicability is deterministic only after the selected identity is known; rejected candidate rows are NOT_APPLICABLE under permanent review/sealing logic, not by a handwritten substitute parser.

A conditional canonical-site patch becomes NOT_APPLICABLE under permanent tooling when an approved target identity matches that same canonical game; the matching target assertion then owns its accepted site evidence.
UNKNOWN or explicit unresolved status is preferable to unsupported site certainty; venue geography alone never establishes H/A/N.
Accepted Saint Louis evidence and reciprocal-program evidence remain distinct even when one is recommended over the other.
